summary: iBio, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the date of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders as October 14, 2026, with a record date of September 1, 2026. Because the meeting is more than 30 days before the anniversary of the 2025 Annual Meeting, the company provides revised deadlines for stockholder proposals: Rule 14a-8 proposals must be received by August 1, 2026. This filing is a routine procedural notice updating shareholder meeting logistics and proxy deadlines; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other special-situation event.
